annotations.title: Approve, deny, suspend, reinstate or remove a campaign creator

description: Decide on a creator in a campaign: approve or deny one waiting to join (joinApproval manual), suspend (their posts stop counting, a retainer pauses, and they are skipped by payouts) or reinstate one, remove one (earnings already approved stay theirs), or grant_retainer: pay a retainer month (period YYYY-MM) that had fewer approved posts than the minimum. move (targetCampaignId): move them to another campaign of the brand, only while no money touched them in this one; posts that fit move, undecided ones that do not are rejected with the reason, and they agree to the new terms on their link (preview without confirm:true). read_creator_campaigns with campaignId shows the ids.

confirm.description: move: true once the user agreed

targetCampaignId.description: move: the campaign to move them to

name: review_campaign_creator
